summary: Refactored apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts into a thin facade that delegates to new cohesive modules (agent-event-hub, pi-agent-types, pi-model-runtime, pi-session-factory, session-catalog-service, session-operations, session-runtime-pool, tool-policy-service), preserving the public PiAgentService import path and behavior. Prettier, server check, and full server test suite (21 files, 114 tests) all pass; session-runtime-pool sits at 300 LOC and the facade at 302 LOC, while the touched session modules are under 300 LOC.
decisions: Split pi-agent-service.ts into a facade plus eight cohesive modules (agent-event-hub, pi-agent-types, pi-model-runtime, pi-session-factory, session-catalog-service, session-operations, session-runtime-pool, tool-policy-service) rather than numbered chunks, reusing existing helpers like session-repository.
Kept the public PiAgentService import path/API intact via re-export `export type * from './pi-agent-types'` and a delegating class so transport/projects remain untouched.
Did not split the existing pi-agent-service.test.ts and pi-agent-service.eviction.test.ts because both already fit under 300 LOC and the eviction suite is already a focused extraction.
session-runtime-pool is intentionally kept at exactly 300 LOC (the cap) rather than further splitting, to avoid an arbitrary numbered chunk.
